notes: §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 SR4 has two bars. The GLOBAL half ('The same data-name must not be used as the name of an item possessing the global attribute and as the name of any other data item described in the program') is DataBinder.ScreenGlobalNameUniqueness (CheckGlobalNameUniquenessPass), COBOL6862 at every edition with a 1985 message arm: probes at 85 refused an elementary and a group-subordinate reuse of a GLOBAL 01 (u4), two GLOBAL 01s of one name (u4), and a WS item named like a record of a GLOBAL FD (u6); the witness is a GLOBAL 01 reused under a group. The EXTERNAL half ('the same data-name must not be used as the name of an external record and as the name of any other external data item described in any program contained within or containing the program which describes that external data record') has no check anywhere: u2 (outer 01 EXR EXTERNAL; contained program 01 OTHER-EXT EXTERNAL / 05 EXR) compiles and runs at 85 and at 2023, and u5 binds the inner EXR to a different 4-byte external area. Open reading, not counted here: the screen asks only of the entry that writes GLOBAL, though §1985:X.4.6.4 GR1 says 'All data-names subordinate to a global name are global names' (u3, a GLOBAL 01's subordinate SUBN reused under a local 01, compiles). Classes a, e, f do not reach a declaration-uniqueness rule. kb/Work PB5427 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-08.json).

next.reason: 1985 bars reusing an external record's data-name for another external item 'described in any program contained within or containing the program which describes that external data record'. 2023 states the bar in the uncataloged prose of §2023:8.4.2.1, 'as the name of any other external data item described in the run unit'. The scope widened from the containment nest to the whole run unit, which covers separately compiled programs: stricter. The global-name half is unchanged ('in the source element that describes that global data item'). The qualification formats map to §2023:8.4.2.2.2, which drops the cd-name qualifier (communication removed) and adds the report-name qualifier and further formats. Catalog defect: the §2023:8.4.2.1 paragraph that carries the external/global bar has no rule id, so 'to' cannot name it.
